entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.3 to 30.24.0.7 (fork commit `d880f416014b`). A translation corpus of every shipped benchmark query across the 20 target dialects and `questdb` (1,262 queries, 26,502 translations, no errors in either runtime) changes in 88 SQLite outputs and no other output. SQLite no longer divides possibly-integer operands with integer truncation: a division the source dialect marks as possibly truncating is written `CAST(dividend AS REAL) / divisor` unless an operand is already real or both operands are integers (literal-only integer division keeps PostgreSQL semantics). Results published before this change for the affected SQLite queries were computed with different SQL.
